question:
In the given figure, what is value (in degrees) of Q?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee58a0c2c1de41afb544fb00775f490f6b9a89f8442345981d54334f2e54fd8d.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a concave quadrilateral (boomerang shape), the reflex angle at the dented vertex is the sum of the three interior tip angles.

Property: Reflex Angle = Angle₁ + Angle₂ + Angle₃

Here, Angle₁ = 70°, Angle₂ = 20°, and Angle₃ = Q.

Reflex Angle = 150°

⇒ 150° = 70° + 20° + Q ⇒ Q = 150° − 90° = 60°

∴ The correct answer is 60°.<
